No inactive private reads or business authority are restored. No enterprise execution; independent whole-backup deletion-log replay remains unfinished.
restoreVeto: Retained contentless deletion metadata and source graph veto every guarded runtime write and acquisition, even when a trusted restorer reinstates an old live lease. Does not certify a whole-backup restore that rolls back the deletion ledger itself. A contentless SECURITY DEFINER tenant/owner predicate keeps this veto after subject departure without enabling private-table reads. Late tool-result retention holds the shared erasure barrier and vetoes restored old attempts; ordinary uncertain effects remain UNKNOWN. Current production does not populate/consume runs.context_ref; the dialogue matrix explicitly distinguishes a trusted synthetic legacy-body restoration fault from actual checkpoint/journal persistence. In-flight delivery receipt retention uses the shared owner barrier and the originally loaded source run. Same-attempt restored content is scrubbed; uncertain already-dispatched effects stay UNKNOWN without redispatch, including after departure. This cannot unsend bytes.
